title: Day and Trial Passes: sponsorship requirement for a tier requiring a corporate sponsor
content:
This document states the basis on which a Day and Trial Passes tier that requires a corporate sponsor (the Corporate Guest Pass, in the current tier basis) may be purchased.

## Rule
A tier that requires a corporate sponsor may be purchased only under an employer's corporate wellness enrollment that is active, and that active enrollment must belong to the same employer that is recorded as sponsoring this particular pass. A pass of that tier purchased beyond the sponsoring employer's monthly allotment for that tier, in the same month, is charged that tier's fee for exceeding the allotment.

## Eligibility checklist
- What is checked: the company's own current record of the sponsoring employer's corporate wellness enrollment status.
- Correlation: that enrollment record must belong to the same employer that is recorded as sponsoring this particular pass, not any other employer's enrollment.
- When it is checked: before the purchase is recorded.
- What satisfies it: the sponsoring employer's corporate wellness enrollment is active.
- What does not satisfy it: the sponsoring employer's corporate wellness enrollment is not active, or the pass names no matching sponsoring employer.
